prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: coherent reference design for an empty-state background in a dark World of Warcraft addon, eventually separated into fixed corner fittings, a left spine strip, and a leather field.
Primary request: a CLOSED, extremely OLD ancient leather adventure chronicle viewed exactly straight down from above. Its battered cover suggests countless adventures preserved within it, centuries of travel and repeated handling. Generate one complete cohesive book cover design, not a collage or asset sheet.
Composition: landscape 4:3 cover fills nearly the entire image, all FOUR metal corner fittings fully visible with a small safe margin. Orthographic flat top-down, parallel sides, no perspective tilt. A distinct narrow leather spine and worn stitched hinge seam run vertically near the LEFT edge. The large middle area is quiet leather with no central emblem, title or imagery, suitable for UI overlay. No surrounding desk or objects.
Materials: thick ancient dark leather, dense fine grain, irregular age cracks, creased compressed edges, softly polished areas from generations of hands, shallow old scratches, small healed scuffs and understated repair stitches near the spine. Weathered, well-loved and structurally intact rather than ruined. Four matching protective metal corner fittings in worn pewter/blackened silver: restrained medieval fantasy scrollwork, pitted surfaces, rubbed raised edges, dulled rivets, shallow engraved details, subtle contact shadows where they attach to the leather. Each corner follows the same ornamental design adapted to its orientation.
Style: highly crafted painterly realistic fantasy game texture with rich tangible material detail, not a modern product photograph or vector illustration. Entirely neutral MONOCHROME grayscale. Soft diffuse illumination from above, modest ambient shading, restrained highlights. Metalwork should emerge gently from the dark leather. The cover will later sit beneath the existing dark translucent UI layer, so retain visible material detail without bright white highlights or already crushing everything to black.
Constraints: no text, letters, runes, logos, icons, central medallion, gems, glowing magic, skulls, skeletons, characters, open pages, projecting paper edges, edge clasp straps, dramatic cast shadows, tabletop, watermark, fake UI, buttons, border labels or asset annotations. The age and storytelling come through physical wear and craftsmanship alone.
